name: ECA Integrated Solution Berhad
summary: ECA Integrated Solution Berhad, an investment holding company, specializes in providing integrated manufacturing systems and individual automated equipment across a global footprint. Its operational reach extends to Malaysia, Europe, other parts of Asia, and North America. Beyond its core offerings, the firm ensures comprehensive post-sales support for its clientele, encompassing technical assistance and the provision of essential spare parts. ECA's client base primarily consists of multinational manufacturers involved in a diverse range of advanced technology sectors. These include the production of semiconductor products, components for electric vehicles and automotive electronics, solar system technology, 5G telecommunications equipment, and digital display tag solutions. The company was established in 2016 and maintains its headquarters in Simpang Ampat, Malaysia.
